item.description: Update on the latest sports March 24, 2026 Soccer fans launch complaint over World Cup ticket prices to European Commission Soccer fans have launched a formal complaint with the European Commission against FIFA over World Cup ticket prices. Football Supporters Europe say it has joined with consumer group Euroconsumers to allege that soccer’s world governing body has abused its position to impose excessive prices.
